$comment: Where the retired-literal list comes from. scripts/check-retired-literals.mjs fetches `path` from `repo` at
`commit` (a full SHA, so the list it reads is exactly the reviewed one) and never keeps a copy here.
`npm run check-retired-literals -- --upstream` compares that list with the one on the upstream default branch
and fails when they differ, so a change upstream turns this repo's CI red instead of lagging silently.
Move `commit` to the upstream commit that changed the list, in its own pull request.
pendingUpstreamMerge: true only while the pinned commit is the head of an open upstream pull request, so the
file is not on the default branch yet; the upstream check then warns instead of failing. Remove it when the pin
